name: Graphite Blueprint
description: A near-black instrument panel: graphite greys, hairlines, pill controls, one indigo for focus. Real UI on spotlit stages, 5x5 dot glyphs for work in progress, isometric hairline blueprints. Suits dev tools, SaaS apps and docs.

provenance.notes: Derived design language; no name, logo, mark, copy, mock content, illustrations, thumbnails or video carried over. Inter (OFL) kept for all text; the commercial mono replaced with Geist Mono (OFL; JetBrains Mono as fallback). Dark is the observed default and the canonical mode; light comes from the reference's documentation theme. Derived, not observed: the light versions of the stage, blueprint, spec plate and dot glyph; the lighter tertiary text and control outlines (contrast); light status hues; form fields and validation, select, checkbox, dialog, toast, banners, dense tables, empty/error/loading states, dot-column charts, the dot strength meter and the generative spec-plate figures.
